Scripts.OnValueChanged: if not(this.SliderValues) then this.SliderValues = {1,5,10,15,30,60,90,120,60*5,60*10,60*15,60*30,60*60,60*90,60*60*2,60*60*5,60*60*10,60*60*20,60*60*24} this:SetMinMaxValues(1,19); end this.secs = this.SliderValues[this:GetValue()]; if (this.secs) == 0 then getglobal(this:GetName().."Label2"):SetText("none") elseif not(this.secs >= 60) then getglobal(this:GetName().."Label2"):SetText(this.secs.." secs") elseif not(this.secs >= 60*60) then local mins = (this.secs/60) getglobal(this:GetName().."Label2"):SetText(mins.." mins") elseif not(this.secs >= 60*60*24) then local hours = (this.secs / (60*60) ); getglobal(this:GetName().."Label2"):SetText(hours.." hours") elseif not(this.secs >= 60*60*24*30) then local days = (this.secs/ (60*60*24) ); getglobal(this:GetName().."Label2"):SetText(days.." days") elseif not(this.secs >= 60*60*24*365) then local months = (this.secs/ (60*60*24*30) ); getglobal(this:GetName().."Label2"):SetText(months.." months") else local years = (this.secs/ (60*60*24*365) ); getglobal(this:GetName().."Label2"):SetText(years.." years") end if not(this.main == nil) then this.main.SetLabel(this.label,this.secs); end
